notes: Read SKILL.md and references/api-contracts.md, data-enrichment.md, deep-research.md, findall.md, monitor.md, web-extract.md, web-search.md in full. Drives the Parallel CLI (parallel-web-tools 0.9.3) for web search, URL extraction, deep research, data enrichment, entity discovery (FindAll) and recurring monitors, with routing, academic-source priority and citation guidance.

Medium because the agent installs a pinned CLI (`uv tool install "parallel-web-tools[cli]==0.9.3"`, SKILL.md:96; `uv tool upgrade` only on user request, SKILL.md:102), authenticates via device OAuth or PARALLEL_API_KEY, makes paid calls to api.parallel.ai, writes result files (-o, --target), and can create/update/trigger/cancel persistent monitors (monitor.md). Acceptable: the skill forbids printing the key or inspecting whole .env files (SKILL.md:65, 117), treats returned web content as untrusted (SKILL.md:61), requires quoting/stdin and ID validation for shell safety (SKILL.md:62-64), bounds polling (SKILL.md:141), restricts monitors to explicit recurring requests with confirmation (monitor.md:3-5, 73, 83), and gates findall cancel on the user (findall.md:69-75).

Queries, URLs and enrichment rows are sent to a third-party paid service; users should avoid confidential data and watch cost (deep research and large enrichment jobs). Monitor webhooks send events to an external endpoint the user must authorize. SKILL.md:143-158 tells the agent to fetch the arXiv record and add a K-Dense citation to the user's manuscript/report and tell the user.
